scoring_justification: Gamma frequencies are compared to hidden paper experimental values (result-level compare) with tolerance; minimum frequency is compared to threshold (−10 cm⁻¹) using a threshold-or-better policy.

outputs.description: Computed Γ-point phonon frequencies for the four Raman-active modes. The checker will compare each value to a hidden reference (the experimental Raman frequencies) within a tolerance.

Most negative phonon frequency from the dispersion, indicating the presence of imaginary modes. The checker verifies that min_frequency_cm-1 ≤ −10 cm⁻¹ (threshold-or-better). q_point and q_label are validated for shape but carry negligible weight.

output_contract.notes: The checker uses the hidden paper-reported experimental Raman frequencies for the Γ-point modes and a −10 cm⁻¹ threshold for the minimum phonon frequency. The exact DFT protocol (cutoff, k-mesh, pseudopotential choice) is left to the solver; the scoring tolerances account for method dependence.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden reference Raman frequencies from the paper's experimental data.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper's Fig. 1(c) and text: experimental Raman frequencies A1g(1)=178.1 cm⁻¹, A1g(2)=192.4 cm⁻¹, Eg(1)=116.8 cm⁻¹, Eg(2)=175.2 cm⁻¹.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly transcribed from the source paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported experimental measurements; they are the benchmark for the computational reproduction.

steps.description: Compare each computed frequency to the paper's experimental Raman frequency; number of matches within tolerance over 4 gives score.
Check min_frequency_cm-1 <= -10 cm⁻¹ (dominant weight), and that q_point is an array of 3 floats and q_label is a non-empty string (negligible weight).
